response.original_title: (Change_Guide) How do I change my room on Silversea Cruise
response.overview: Changing your room on a Silversea Cruise +1-866-829-1280 (US) is possible if another stateroom is available. If you booked directly, contact Silversea Cruise Reservations +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) or use the live chat to speak with an agent. Guests who booked through a travel advisor should request the change through their advisor. Depending on your fare type, deposit status, +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) and cabin category, changing rooms may require repricing, cancellation, or payment of any applicable fare difference. Changing your Silversea Cruise stateroom is easiest when requested early, +1-866-829-1280 (US) before cabin availability becomes limited. Contact Silversea Cruise or your travel advisor to explore available options and any associated costs. If you are already onboard, +1-866-829-1280 (US) or you may also inquire at Guest Services about possible upgrades or room changes, subject to availability.
